name: Legacy Acres
headline: One of my favorite places to film a wedding
insiderKnowledge: Legacy Acres was one of the very first venues I ever filmed a wedding at, and it's remained one of my favorites ever since — I've shot more weddings here than almost anywhere else. The showstopper is the ballroom, a massive 14,000-square-foot space that gives me room to pull back and capture the reception fly-on-the-wall style, letting real, unposed moments unfold naturally instead of feeling boxed in by a tight room. Set against Conway's rural landscape of small forests and open sky, the whole estate has a look that films beautifully no matter which direction you point the camera.

Between the natural scenery behind the chapel, the fishing pond by the outdoor pavilion, and wide-open grounds that catch golden hour in the most gorgeous way, Legacy Acres gives me endless options for portraits and B-roll alike. It's a venue that rewards a videographer who knows it well — and after all these years and countless weddings here, I still find new light and new angles every time I'm back.
heroTitle: Legacy Acres — Southern Charm Across 40 Acres of Timeless Beauty
heroSub: A sprawling Conway estate of rolling grounds, small forests, and a fishing pond — where every celebration becomes a masterpiece.

cta.subline: You've chosen a venue with real character — let's make sure your film has it too.
